documentation.content: Runbook row: Redis pressure and fallback (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Runtime observations). Responder: on-call API responder. Log-based metric rate_limit_fallback (infra/monitoring/metrics/rate-limit-fallback.json) crossing zero occurrences in a 5-minute window; the app.operational emitter already throttles to at most one record per 600 seconds per process. A useful first notification, with the runbook's reviewed 15-minute notification throttle and an explicit incident follow-up; not a request-error-rate calculation. Initial, review after 7 days.
